title: Representation signal versus population-endpoint sensitivity on the existing S24-7-M11 embedding cache
purpose: One integrated exploratory diagnostic with three predeclared branches: A whether admitted embeddings carry an abnormality-associated contrast inside a robot|program stratum, B whether occupancy E2 misses within-prototype movement that a bounded residual diagnostic can see, and C whether the accepted estimators resolve known, reference-derived embedding shifts at supported sample sizes. Not a replacement business endpoint, file-accuracy objective, revision of M11-M13 or independent confirmation.

custody.data_exposure_disclosure: The corpus, the accepted M9 audit and the admitted M11 embeddings were available before this specification was written. The design is therefore exploratory, not pre-registered: no fresh confirmation, no temporal holdout and no stronger custody claim is made.
custody.amendments: Any later deviation is recorded as a separate timestamped JSON amendment declaring amends_spec_sha256; the original specification bytes are never edited and deviations are measured, not back-filled.

inputs.admission: identity-strict accepted public admission path; 24,840 required rows, 18 groups, no recapture
inputs.reference_pool: 220 causal REFERENCE files per history, fixed before any evaluation period

E1.kernel: Gaussian, bandwidth sigma = median pairwise distance of the causal reference pool per (history, encoder seed)
E1.fit_isolation: bandwidth and prototypes are fitted on the causal REFERENCE pool only and never on labels, families, severities or evaluation arms

E2.definition: occupancy total-variation distance against the accepted causal-reference prototypes
E2.exact_quanta: with s rows per arm E2 = m / s for an integer numerator m = half the absolute count difference, computed in integer arithmetic
E2.blind_spot: E2 reacts only to which prototype receives mass; movement inside one prototype is invisible to it

D_LOC.definition: sum over prototypes occupied in both arms of w_k * ||mean_A(r_k) - mean_B(r_k)||^2, divided by the reference residual scale
D_LOC.residuals: r_i = x_i - c_{label(i)} with the fixed causal-reference centroid of the row's prototype
D_LOC.weights: w_k = (n_A,k + n_B,k) / (2s), renormalised over the common prototypes
D_LOC.reference_scale: mean squared residual norm over the causal-reference rows of the same (history, seed, K)
D_LOC.directionality: a vector norm, so every direction of movement counts; radial and tangential components are published separately at K=8

D_SPREAD.definition: sum over common prototypes of w_k * |mean_A(||r_k||^2) - mean_B(||r_k||^2)|, divided by the reference residual scale

directional_decomposition.radial: squared projection of the mean-residual difference on the unit centroid direction, weighted and normalised as D_LOC
directional_decomposition.tangential: the remaining squared norm of the same difference; radial alone is never read as all directional movement

estimators.coverage: sum of w_k over common prototypes before renormalisation; a repeat below d_min_coverage is abstained, never silently renormalised

branch_a.unit: one accepted history x horizon cell x robot|program stratum x supported per-arm size
branch_a.cell_periods: the accepted M9 pair-row low-burden and elevated period identities of the cell; no period added or dropped
branch_a.support_rule: n_abnormal >= s and n_normal >= 3s inside the stratum and cell periods; otherwise a closed abstention code

arms_per_repeat.abnormal: s files drawn without replacement from the stratum's abnormal candidates
arms_per_repeat.normal_1: s files from a 3s normal draw without replacement and a permutation split
arms_per_repeat.normal_2: the second disjoint s-file third of the same normal draw; used as the null arm A
arms_per_repeat.normal_3: the third disjoint s-file third of the same normal draw; used as the null arm B
arms_per_repeat.matched_null: normal_2 versus normal_3 at the identical size, estimator and seed
arms_per_repeat.disjointness: labels separate the abnormal and normal pools; the three normal arms are disjoint by construction and every draw is without replacement

period_control_variant.name: PERIOD-MATCHED
period_control_variant.rule: per-period quota = capped largest-remainder apportionment of s with weights = abnormal availability and caps = min(n_abnormal_p, floor(n_normal_p / 3)), so the abnormal arm and all three normal arms carry the same per-period counts exactly
period_control_variant.feasibility: reported per unit; infeasible units carry ABSTAIN-PERIOD-MATCH-INFEASIBLE and stay in the denominator
period_control_variant.support_census: 52 of 960 units computed, all other units explicitly abstained

pooled_variant.name: POOLED-PERIOD
pooled_variant.caveat: the stratum mixes source periods; the period-mix total-variation distance between the comparison arms is reported per repeat and the pooled contrast is not period-controlled

branch_a.labels: used only to construct and diagnose the abnormal/normal arms; never an input to a bandwidth, prototype, encoder, reference fit or detector selection
branch_a.composition_reporting: family counts, accepted severity and anomalous-fraction bins, duration quartile bins and median severity/fraction/duration of the abnormal candidates; period counts; exact candidate identities; distinct files used and possible draws
branch_a.weak_result_rule: a weak or absent measured contrast is not proof that the representation carries no abnormality signal

branch_b.design: the same valid branch-A arms and null bands are scored with E1, E2 at K in {4,8,16}, D_LOC and D_SPREAD; no endpoint is re-drawn or re-matched for its own result
branch_b.within_prototype_only_flag: a unit-seed is counted as within-prototype-only when the E2_K8 contrast median is exactly zero while D_LOC_K8 is above the matched normal-normal null q95

boundary_handling.margins: margin = (d_second - d_first) / 2 under the fixed K=8 prototypes
boundary_handling.proximity_fraction: share of each arm's rows with margin <= 0.25 * sqrt(reference residual scale), published descriptively
boundary_handling.reassignment: per-file prototype changes are measurable only for the paired positive-control arms (branch C), not for disjoint real-source arms; the report states this instead of inventing a pairing

branch_b.empty_cluster_handling: a prototype empty in either arm is excluded from D and the weights are renormalised over the common prototypes; coverage records the excluded mass and a repeat below 0.5 coverage is abstained

branch_c.unit: one accepted cell x supported size x encoder seed
branch_c.normal_quota: capped largest-remainder apportionment of s over robot|program strata with weights = normal availability and caps = floor(n_normal / 2), so two disjoint equal-quota arms fit; all 24 cell x size units are census-supported

arms.unchanged: s normal files drawn without replacement inside the quota
arms.perturbed_base: a second disjoint s-file normal draw inside the same quota

perturbation.direction: first right singular vector of the centred causal-reference embedding matrix per (history, seed), sign fixed so the largest absolute loading is positive
perturbation.sigma_u: root-mean-square projection of the centred reference rows on that direction
perturbation.magnitude_units: reference directional standard deviations; the realised shift vector and its norm are published exactly

modes.GLOBAL-SHIFT: every row of the perturbed arm is shifted
modes.WITHIN-PROTOTYPE-SAFE: only rows whose K=8 boundary margin strictly exceeds the shift norm are shifted, so the nearest prototype cannot change by the triangle inequality; the perturbed count and fraction are published and a repeat with fraction < 0.5 is abstained

perturbation.zero_shift: delta = 0.0 is a single record that is also the unchanged-versus-unchanged null band
perturbation.not_label_derived: the direction and the grid use only the causal reference pool and no evaluation label or outcome

branch_c.identity_check: the unchanged arm compared with itself must give biased E1 exactly 0, E2 exactly 0 for every K, D_LOC and D_SPREAD exactly 0 and zero reassignment; the accepted unbiased E1 is not zero on identical samples by its own diagonal and its exact identity value is published instead of being claimed as zero
branch_c.reassignment: per-file prototype label change under the fixed K=8 prototypes for every perturbed record at every K, with the realised shift norm
branch_c.responsiveness_statistic: share of repeats above the delta=0 null q95 for every estimator, reported as measurement responsiveness only
branch_c.no_business_claim: artificial shifts verify measurement responsiveness only: not learned anomaly semantics, generalisation, significance/power guarantees or business success

reproducibility.deterministic: identical inputs, sizes, repeats and seeds must reproduce every table byte-for-byte
reproducibility.no_pseudo_n: no duplicate file identity inflates any arm; every draw is without replacement and every arm pair is disjoint

accounting.branch_a: 960 planned units x 3 seeds x 6 accounting estimators; every unit is COMPUTED or a closed abstention
accounting.branch_a_period_matched: the same 960 planned units with their own census status
accounting.branch_c: 72 planned unit-seeds x 11 comparison records (delta=0 once, five positive deltas x two modes) and one identity record; eight estimators per comparison record
accounting.estimator_grid_note: the six accounting estimators are E1, E2_K4, E2_K8, E2_K16, D_LOC and D_SPREAD; D_RADIAL and D_TANGENTIAL at K=8 are descriptive decomposition of D_LOC and are published but not counted as separate endpoints

verification.independent_numeric: a separate verifier recomputes E1, E2 and D from the persisted arm identities without importing the audit module
verification.invariants: arm size matching, disjointness, no duplicate identity, integer-even occupancy quanta, null-band construction, abstention accounting and deterministic reproduction
verification.positive_controls: zero-shift identity exact zeros, exact known shift norms, boundary-safe zero-reassignment behaviour and the realised reassignment counts
verification.real_smoke: the public cache-only command is exercised end to end on the admitted 24,840-row cache
verification.no_gate: no quantitative success gate; an honest negative or inconclusive result satisfies execution acceptance

limitations: Exploratory and post-exposure; not pre-registered and not a fresh confirmation.
Branch A sizes are tiny because within-stratum abnormal support is 1-10 files; the matched null band is the only comparator.
Only 52 of 960 branch-A units support exact period matching; the rest report a measured period-mix confounder or abstain.
The accepted unbiased E1 has a non-zero identical-sample diagonal; the zero check uses the biased plug-in and exact E2/D zeros.
Positive controls show measurement responsiveness only; they do not establish anomaly semantics, power or business value.
Weekly and monthly cells, the six histories and the three seeds stay separate; no pooled representation claim is made.
